reviews.title: Hopelessly incapable
reviews.text: Red Kites and Robins are particularly easy to identify by their calls but this app didn’t have a clue. My friend’s Merlin was also beyond the app’s capabilities. It did correctly identify a wood pigeon but even a five year old can get that one right.
Tried it once and it didn’t work

reviews.title: Why lie?
reviews.text: It’s not free. It needs subscription

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text:
This is a really poor app. Using sound it only identifies 1 possible 2 birds whereas there is at least 4. And you have to be close. 
Tested the photo ID of a Siskin. I had to crop the photo to only include the bird. It came back as a green finch. 
Don’t waste your money! There are better and cheaper (free apps) out there

reviews.title: Doesn’t work anymore
reviews.text: This was an excellent app, and the daily bird photo is still on my iPhone 11, but just crashes if I try to open it. Totally non-functional now
